- [EVENT] User is thinking of organizing their closet soon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for organizing a closet:
  1. Purge before organizing: sort items into keep, donate/sell, and discard piles.
  2. Categorize and group similar items.
  3. Assign a home for each item.
  4. Use storage containers and label them.
  5. Implement a "one in, one out" policy.
  6. Utilize vertical space.
  7. Keep shoes in order.
  8. Hang clothes by type.
  9. Use dividers or bins for accessories.
  10. Keep a donation bin handy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for closet organization include investing in a closet organizer system and storing out-of-season clothes in bins.
